summary_en: Isuzu Motors executed a block acquisition of 14.5 million shares at 2,125 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 9, 2026 morning, representing 2.1% of outstanding shares. This execution was authorized under the company's November 6, 2026 board resolution for a 35 million share buyback program with a 50 billion yen budget through March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Matching System (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Isuzu Motors' board of directors authorized a share buyback program and executed a specific block acquisition through an off-hours matching system. The company placed a buying order at the fixed price of 2,125 yen per share—the closing price on November 6—for execution on November 9, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. through the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 facility. The execution resulted in the acquisition of 14.5 million shares, equivalent to 30.8125 billion yen and 2.1% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).

This block execution was part of the broader buyback authorization announced on the same date. That authorization permits the acquisition of up to 35 million shares (5.1% of outstanding shares) for up to 50 billion yen through March 31, 2027, using both ToSTNeT-3 and conventional market purchases. The board delegated detailed implementation decisions to the CFO.
